description:
Read the properties and relationships of a passiveDnsRecord object.

TIP: Lists passive DNS records from Microsoft Defender Threat Intelligence. Each has firstSeenDateTime, lastSeenDateTime, recordType, and associated host/parentHost. Use $filter=host/id eq 'example.com' to find DNS history for a domain.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.

name: list-passive-dns-records
